Minikube is a tool for running Kubernetes locally.

Usage:
  minikube [command]

Available Commands:
  start       Start a local Kubernetes cluster
  stop        Stop a running local Kubernetes cluster
  delete      Delete a local Kubernetes cluster
  status      Get the status of a local Kubernetes cluster
  tunnel      Expose LoadBalancer services to localhost
  addons      Modify minikube addons
  dashboard  Access the Kubernetes dashboard
  ssh         Log into or run a command on the minikube VM
  version     Print the version of minikube

Flags:
  -h, --help      help for minikube
  -p, --profile   Profile name to use
      --logtostderr   log to standard error instead of files

Use "minikube [command] --help" for more information about a command.
